meta.title: RAG Meets Temporal Graphs: Time-Sensitive Modeling and Retrieval for Evolving Knowledge
meta.paper_type_explanation: Proposes Temporal GraphRAG (TG-RAG), a new framework for time-aware RAG using bi-level temporal graphs with incremental update support.

A_data_and_task.domain_data_type_explanation: Focuses on earnings call transcripts from financial reports of public companies across sectors.
A_data_and_task.task_type_explanation: Time-sensitive question answering including specific multi-hop fact-based queries and abstract trend/summarization queries over evolving financial corpora.
A_data_and_task.dataset_characteristics_explanation: ECT-QA derived from 480 earnings call transcripts (1.58M tokens) from 24 companies; base corpus 2020-2023 (384 docs), new corpus 2024 (96 docs); 1,105 specific QA pairs + 100 abstract questions.
A_data_and_task.benchmark_metrics_explanation: LLM-judged factual accuracy (Correct/Refusal/Incorrect ratios) for specific QA; ROUGE-L/F1 for lexical overlap; multi-dimensional LLM judging (Comprehensiveness, Diversity, Temporal Coverage) for abstract QA.

B_graph_kg_structure.graph_kg_representation_type_explanation: Bi-level temporal graph: lower layer temporal KG with timestamped relations (quadruples: entity-relation-entity-time); upper layer hierarchical time graph (year>quarter>month>day).
B_graph_kg_structure.graph_evolution_type_explanation: Supports incremental updates by merging new timestamped relations; preserves historical evolution as distinct parallel edges; maintains multi-granularity time reports via ancestor propagation.
B_graph_kg_structure.node_types_explanation: Non-temporal entities in KG layer; time nodes (timestamps organized hierarchically); temporal summaries/reports per time node.
B_graph_kg_structure.edge_types_explanation: Timestamped relation edges (v1-v2-relation-τ); cross-layer edges from time nodes to active relations; hierarchical edges in time graph (parent-child intervals).
B_graph_kg_structure.graph_schema_explanation: No fixed ontology mentioned; relations extracted dynamically via LLM from text chunks.
B_graph_kg_structure.graph_scale_explanation: Base corpus: 16,817 entities, 28,157 relations; updated: 20,110 entities, 34,671 relations.

C_temporal_modeling_and_queries.temporal_structure_type_explanation: Bi-level: temporal KG (timestamped edges) + hierarchical time graph; multi-granularity summaries per time node.
C_temporal_modeling_and_queries.temporal_granularity_explanation: Hierarchical time buckets (year/quarter/month/day); recursive summary propagation from leaf to ancestors.
C_temporal_modeling_and_queries.temporal_representation_explanation: Normalized timestamps (e.g., 2023-Q1); supports at/before/after/between via LLM extraction.
C_temporal_modeling_and_queries.temporal_query_handling_explanation: LLM extracts explicit/implicit temporal expressions from query to identify relevant time nodes T_q.
C_temporal_modeling_and_queries.temporal_conflict_redundancy_handling_ex: Preserves identical relations at different times as distinct edges; no explicit conflict detection mentioned.
C_temporal_modeling_and_queries.temporal_decay_obsolescence_explanation: No decay; historical facts preserved via timestamped parallel edges.
C_temporal_modeling_and_queries.multi_hop_temporal_reasoning_explanation: PPR on temporally filtered subgraph; supports single/multi/relative-time multi-hop queries.

D_dynamic_update_mechanisms.update_trigger_explanation: Triggered by new documents; extracts quadruples and merges into graph.
D_dynamic_update_mechanisms.update_policy_control_logic_explanation: Generate reports only for new leaf time nodes and propagate to ancestors.
D_dynamic_update_mechanisms.update_scope_explanation: New temporal quadruples merged; new time nodes added; summaries updated incrementally.
D_dynamic_update_mechanisms.verification_pipeline_explanation: No explicit verification; relies on LLM extraction.
D_dynamic_update_mechanisms.conflict_resolution_strategy_explanation: Conflicts avoided by distinct edges for same relation at different times; provenance via original chunks.
D_dynamic_update_mechanisms.incremental_construction_explanation: LLM extracts entities/relations/timestamps from new chunks; merges into existing graph.

update_latency_throughput.update_throughput: Low token cost (1.6M prompt/2.0M completion for 2024 corpus)

D_dynamic_update_mechanisms.update_latency_throughput_explanation: Incremental: 1.6M/2.0M tokens for new corpus vs GraphRAG's 30M/7.8M.

E_retrieval_and_reasoning.retrieval_unit_granularity_explanation: Chunks, timestamped edges, time reports/summaries, temporally filtered subgraphs.
E_retrieval_and_reasoning.temporal_awareness_in_retrieval_explanat: Temporal filtering 1[τ ∈ T_q]; PPR personalization on time-seed entities.
E_retrieval_and_reasoning.retrieval_strategy_explanation: Local: PPR on subgraph + chunk scoring; Global: time reports + atomic points; vector similarity for initial K edges.
E_retrieval_and_reasoning.retrieval_indexing_explanation: Bi-level graph with precomputed entity/relation embeddings; hierarchical time index.
E_retrieval_and_reasoning.reasoning_generation_protocol_explanatio: Local: LLM on retrieved chunks; Global: LLM extracts atomic points (desc/score/confidence) then synthesizes.
E_retrieval_and_reasoning.multi_hop_reasoning_support_explanation: PPR propagates relevance in query subgraph.
E_retrieval_and_reasoning.context_window_management_explanation: Greedy pack top chunks/reports to L_ctx; iterative low-confidence point removal.

F_llm_role_and_learning.llm_role_in_system_explanation: Extracts temporal quadruples; generates multi-granularity reports; query time extraction; QA generation.
F_llm_role_and_learning.llm_adaptation_mode_explanation: Uses off-the-shelf LLMs (Gemini-2.5-flash-lite for indexing, GPT-4o-mini for QA).

llm_integration_pattern.as_reasoner: Query time parsing, atomic point extraction

F_llm_role_and_learning.llm_integration_pattern_explanation: LLM for extraction (entities/relations/timestamps), summarization, and generation.
F_llm_role_and_learning.prompt_engineering_explanation: Few-shot examples for temporal parsing; specialized prompts for local/global QA with temporal accuracy and refusal guidelines.

G_evaluation_and_practical.evaluation_focus_explanation: Incremental eval: base queries on base/updated corpus; new queries on updated; update token costs.
G_evaluation_and_practical.evaluation_metrics_explanation: TG-RAG: Correct 0.599 (base), 0.587/0.617 (updated base/new); low update cost.
G_evaluation_and_practical.baseline_comparisons_explanation: Outperforms baselines on ECT-QA; stable perf post-update; generalizes to NQ/HotpotQA.
G_evaluation_and_practical.graph_summarization_compression_explanat: Multi-granularity time reports aggregating child summaries + connected facts.
G_evaluation_and_practical.explainability_explanation: Subgraph visualization; retrieved chunks/relations with timestamps.
G_evaluation_and_practical.real_world_deployment_explanation: Designed for evolving corpora like financial reports; no production mention.

H_novel_technical_contributions.algorithmic_innovations_explanation: Query-centric time ID; dynamic subgraph PPR with temporal edge scoring.
H_novel_technical_contributions.architecture_patterns_explanation: Bi-level temporal graph; local (fine-grained facts) + global (summaries) retrieval.
H_novel_technical_contributions.memory_storage_explanation: Embeddings + graph structure; summaries for compression.
H_novel_technical_contributions.attention_mechanisms_explanation: No neural attention; PPR for propagation.
H_novel_technical_contributions.neural_architecture_explanation: Precomputed text embeddings for entities/relations; no GNNs.

I_reproducibility_implementation.implementation_details_explanation: Chunk size 1200/overlap 100; K=20 relations; Gemini-2.5-flash-lite indexing, GPT-4o-mini QA.
I_reproducibility_implementation.hyperparameters_explanation: Top-K=20 relations; context limits 12K local/24K global tokens.

J_limitations_future_work.acknowledged_limitations_explanation: No explicit limitations section; assumes high-quality LLM extraction.

K_cross_cutting_concerns.provenance_trust_explanation: Edges linked to source chunks; global retrieval uses LLM self-assessed confidence.
K_cross_cutting_concerns.domain_adaptation_explanation: Strong on financial ECT-QA; generalizes to NQ/HotpotQA.
K_cross_cutting_concerns.human_in_the_loop_explanation: Dataset uses human review for QA quality.

notable_contributions_explanation: Addresses time-sensitivity in RAG via explicit temporal KG; new incremental eval protocol; outperforms baselines significantly.

extraction_metadata.extraction_notes: Based on abstract, intro, methods, results; quantitative results from tables; code/dataset released.
